# HT1080 Y/X Ratio Across Passages

## Data Loading

```{r load-function}
# Reusable function to load and process one run directory
load_run <- function(run_dir, y_target = "AMELY", x_target = "AMELX") {

  # --- Plate metadata ---
  all_csvs <- list.files(run_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  plate_csv <- NULL
  for (f in all_csvs) {
    first_line <- readLines(f, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
    if (grepl("^ddplate", first_line)) { plate_csv <- f; break }
  }
  if (!is.null(plate_csv)) {
    plate <- data.table::fread(plate_csv, skip = 4)
  } else {
    plate_path <- file.path(run_dir, "plate.csv")
    if (file.exists(plate_path)) {
      plate <- data.table::fread(plate_path, skip = 4)
    } else {
      # Fall back to data_table.csv for plate metadata
      dt_path <- file.path(run_dir, "data_table.csv")
      if (file.exists(dt_path)) {
        dt_raw <- data.table::fread(dt_path)
        # Rename Target to TargetName if needed
        if ("Target" %in% names(dt_raw) && !("TargetName" %in% names(dt_raw))) {
          dt_raw$TargetName <- dt_raw$Target
        }
        plate <- dt_raw %>%
          dplyr::select(Well, `Sample description 1`, TargetName) %>%
          as.data.frame()
      } else {
        stop("No plate metadata CSV found in: ", run_dir)
      }
    }
  }
  plate <- plate %>% dplyr::distinct(Well, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # --- Amplitude CSVs ---
  files <- list.files(run_dir, pattern = "_Amplitude\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

  amp_list <- lapply(files, function(y) {
    df <- data.table::fread(y, skip = 4)
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- df[, 1:4, with = FALSE]
    names(df) <- c("Ch1Amplitude", "Ch2Amplitude", y_target, x_target)
    df$Ch1Amplitude <- as.numeric(df$Ch1Amplitude)
    df$Ch2Amplitude <- as.numeric(df$Ch2Amplitude)
    df[[3]] <- as.numeric(df[[3]])
    df[[4]] <- as.numeric(df[[4]])
    return(df)
  })

  # Classify droplets, extract well
  amp_list <- lapply(seq_along(amp_list), function(x) {
    df <- amp_list[[x]]
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    names(df)[which(names(df) == y_target)] <- "Y"
    names(df)[which(names(df) == x_target)] <- "X"

    df$call <- ifelse(df$X == 0 & df$Y == 1, "Y+",
               ifelse(df$X == 1 & df$Y == 0, "Y-",
               ifelse(df$X == 1 & df$Y == 1, "X+Y", "empty")))

    parts <- str_split(basename(files)[x], "_", simplify = TRUE)
    well_idx <- which(grepl("^[A-H][0-9]{2}$", parts))
    df$well <- if (length(well_idx) > 0) parts[well_idx[length(well_idx)]] else paste0("W", x)
    return(df)
  })

  amp_list <- amp_list[!sapply(amp_list, is.null)]
  l <- data.table::rbindlist(amp_list) %>% tidyr::drop_na(call)
  l$Ch1Amplitude <- as.numeric(l$Ch1Amplitude)
  l$Ch2Amplitude <- as.numeric(l$Ch2Amplitude)
  l$Y <- as.numeric(l$Y)
  l$X <- as.numeric(l$X)

  # Join plate metadata
  l <- dplyr::left_join(l,
    plate %>% dplyr::select(Well, `Sample description 1`, TargetName),
    by = c("well" = "Well"))
  l <- l %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Sample description 1`) &
                            !(`Sample description 1` %in% c("NTC", "")))
  l$name <- paste0(l$well, "_", l$`Sample description 1`)

  # --- data_table.csv (optional) ---
  dt_path <- file.path(run_dir, "data_table.csv")
  dt <- if (file.exists(dt_path)) {
    d <- data.table::fread(dt_path)
    d$name <- paste0(d$Well, "_", d$`Sample description 1`)
    d
  } else NULL

  list(droplets = l, plate = plate, dt = dt, run_dir = run_dir)
}
```

```{r combine-filter}
# Combine all runs
all_droplets <- dplyr::bind_rows(nov13$droplets, nov7$droplets, feb26$droplets)

# Filter to HT1080 only (sample names contain HT1080, or passage patterns P1-P4/D0)
ht1080_pattern <- "HT1080|^[A-H][0-9]{2}_(D0|P[1-4])"
all_droplets <- all_droplets %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl(ht1080_pattern, name, ignore.case = TRUE))

# Keep Y-linked target rows only (exclude reference-only targets like RNaseP)
all_droplets <- all_droplets %>%
  dplyr::filter(TargetName %in% c("AMELY", "AMELX", "KDM5D", "DDX3Y"))

cat(sprintf("HT1080: %d droplets, %d wells\n",
    nrow(all_droplets), length(unique(all_droplets$name))))
```

## Droplet Classification

```{r classify}
# Aggregate counts per well
counts <- all_droplets %>%
  dplyr::group_by(name, `Sample description 1`, call, run, TargetName) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  reshape2::dcast(name + run + TargetName ~ call, value.var = "n")
counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0

for (col in c("Y+", "Y-", "X+Y", "empty")) {
  if (!(col %in% names(counts))) counts[[col]] <- 0
}

# Extract well and sample description
counts$well <- str_split(counts$name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
counts$sample_desc <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", counts$name)

# Probe arm: AMELY = Yp arm, KDM5D/DDX3Y = Yq arm
counts$probe_arm <- ifelse(counts$TargetName %in% c("AMELY", "AMELX"),
                           "Yp (AMELY/AMELX)", "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)")

# Calculate ratios
counts <- counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio      = (`Y+` + `X+Y`) / (`Y-` + `X+Y`),
    total      = `Y+` + `Y-` + `X+Y` + empty,
    empty_rate = empty / total,
    double_rate = `X+Y` / total
  )

# Parse passage and condition from sample_desc
# Look for D0/P1-P4/Parental anywhere in the string (Feb 26 names have HT1080_ prefix)
counts$passage <- str_extract(counts$sample_desc, "(D0|P[1-4]|Parental)")
# Only fall back to "Parental" for samples containing HT1080 but no passage marker
counts$passage <- ifelse(is.na(counts$passage) & grepl("HT1080", counts$sample_desc),
                         "Parental", counts$passage)

counts$condition <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("LOY", counts$sample_desc) ~ "LOY",
  grepl("CTRL", counts$sample_desc) ~ "CTRL",
  grepl("Parental", counts$sample_desc) ~ "Parental",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# Order passage as factor
counts$passage <- factor(counts$passage,
  levels = c("Parental", "D0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"))
```

```{r per-well-table}
counts %>%
  dplyr::select(name, run, passage, condition, probe_arm, ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(passage, condition) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Per-well ratios — HT1080")
```

## Pooled Replicates

```{r pool-replicates}
pooled <- counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(passage, condition, probe_arm) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_wells  = dplyr::n(),
    wells    = paste(well, collapse = "+"),
    `Y+`     = sum(`Y+`),
    `Y-`     = sum(`Y-`),
    `X+Y`    = sum(`X+Y`),
    empty    = sum(empty),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total       = `Y+` + `Y-` + `X+Y` + empty,
    ratio       = (`Y+` + `X+Y`) / (`Y-` + `X+Y`),
    empty_rate  = empty / total,
    double_rate = `X+Y` / total
  )

pooled %>%
  dplyr::select(passage, condition, probe_arm, wells, n_wells, ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Pooled replicate ratios by passage, condition, and probe arm")
```

## Passage Time-Course

```{r passage-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Individual well points
well_data <- counts %>% dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("LOY", "CTRL", "Parental"))

# Pooled line data
line_data <- pooled %>% dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("LOY", "CTRL", "Parental"))

# Interaction group for dodging: condition × probe_arm
well_data$cond_arm <- interaction(well_data$condition, well_data$probe_arm, sep = " / ")
line_data$cond_arm <- interaction(line_data$condition, line_data$probe_arm, sep = " / ")

pd <- position_dodge(0.15)

ggplot() +
  # Individual wells as semi-transparent points
  geom_point(data = well_data,
    aes(x = passage, y = ratio, color = condition, shape = probe_arm),
    size = 3, alpha = 0.5, position = pd) +
  # Pooled values as larger points + lines
  geom_point(data = line_data,
    aes(x = passage, y = ratio, color = condition, shape = probe_arm),
    size = 4, position = pd) +
  geom_line(data = line_data,
    aes(x = passage, y = ratio, color = condition, group = cond_arm,
        linetype = probe_arm),
    linewidth = 1, position = pd) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("LOY" = "#E64B35", "CTRL" = "#4DBBD5", "Parental" = "#00A087")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = 16, "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = 17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = "solid", "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = "dashed")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.15)) +
  labs(
    title = "HT1080 — Y/X Ratio Across Passages",
    subtitle = "Circle = Yp arm (AMELY/AMELX); Triangle = Yq arm (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)",
    x = "Passage", y = "Y / Reference Ratio",
    color = "Condition", shape = "Probe Locus", linetype = "Probe Locus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )
```

## Per-Well Ratio Bar Plot

```{r per-well-barplot, fig.height=5, fig.width=11}
well_data$label <- paste0(well_data$sample_desc, " (", well_data$well, ")")

# Use linetype on bars to distinguish probe arm (solid vs dashed border)
ggplot(well_data, aes(x = reorder(label, as.numeric(passage)),
                      y = ratio, fill = condition, linetype = probe_arm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("LOY" = "#E64B35", "CTRL" = "#4DBBD5", "Parental" = "#00A087")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = "solid",
                                   "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = "dashed")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.15)) +
  labs(title = "HT1080 — Per-Well Ratios",
       y = "Y / Reference Ratio", x = "",
       fill = "Condition", linetype = "Probe Locus") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
```

## QC Metrics

```{r qc-metrics, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
qc_data <- counts %>%
  dplyr::select(name, passage, condition, empty_rate, double_rate, total) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(passage, condition)

qc_rates <- qc_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(empty_rate, double_rate),
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(metric = ifelse(metric == "empty_rate", "Empty Rate", "Double Rate"))

p1 <- ggbarplot(qc_rates, x = "name", y = "value", fill = "metric",
                position = position_dodge(), palette = c("#3C5488", "#E64B35")) %>%
  ggpar(x.text.angle = 45, font.x = c(6), ylab = "Rate", xlab = "",
        title = "Empty & Double Rates", legend.title = "Metric")

p2 <- ggbarplot(qc_data, x = "name", y = "total", fill = "condition",
                palette = c("LOY" = "#E64B35", "CTRL" = "#4DBBD5", "Parental" = "#00A087")) %>%
  ggpar(x.text.angle = 45, font.x = c(6), ylab = "Accepted Droplets", xlab = "",
        title = "Total Droplets per Well", legend.title = "Condition")

ggarrange(p1, p2, nrow = 1)
```

## Concentration Ratio Across Passages

```{r concentration-passage, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
# Combine data_table from all runs
dt_list <- list()
for (run_obj in list(nov13, nov7, feb26)) {
  if (!is.null(run_obj$dt)) {
    d <- run_obj$dt
    d$run_src <- basename(run_obj$run_dir)
    dt_list <- c(dt_list, list(d))
  }
}

# Y-linked targets and their paired references
y_targets <- c("AMELY", "KDM5D", "DDX3Y")
ref_targets <- c("AMELX", "RNaseP")

if (length(dt_list) > 0) {
  dt_all <- data.table::rbindlist(dt_list, fill = TRUE)

  # Filter to HT1080
  dt_ht <- dt_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("HT1080|D0|P[1-4]", `Sample description 1`))

  # Separate Y-target and reference rows
  dt_y <- dt_ht %>% dplyr::filter(Target %in% y_targets)
  dt_ref <- dt_ht %>% dplyr::filter(Target %in% ref_targets)

  if (nrow(dt_y) > 0 && nrow(dt_ref) > 0) {
    # Get Y-target concentration per well (keep Target name for probe_arm)
    y_conc <- dt_y %>%
      dplyr::select(name, Target, `Conc(copies/µL)`) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Y_Conc = as.numeric(`Conc(copies/µL)`),
                    y_target_name = Target) %>%
      dplyr::select(name, y_target_name, Y_Conc)

    # Get reference concentration per well (match by Well)
    ref_conc <- dt_ref %>%
      dplyr::select(name, `Conc(copies/µL)`) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Ref_Conc = as.numeric(`Conc(copies/µL)`)) %>%
      dplyr::select(name, Ref_Conc)

    conc <- dplyr::left_join(y_conc, ref_conc, by = "name")
    conc$Conc_ratio <- conc$Y_Conc / conc$Ref_Conc

    # Add passage/condition metadata
    conc$sample_desc <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", conc$name)
    conc$passage <- str_extract(conc$sample_desc, "(D0|P[1-4]|Parental)")
    conc$passage <- ifelse(is.na(conc$passage) & grepl("HT1080", conc$sample_desc),
                           "Parental", conc$passage)
    conc$passage <- factor(conc$passage, levels = c("Parental", "D0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"))
    conc$condition <- dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("LOY", conc$sample_desc) ~ "LOY",
      grepl("CTRL", conc$sample_desc) ~ "CTRL",
      grepl("Parental", conc$sample_desc) ~ "Parental",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )

    # Probe arm from Y-target name
    conc$probe_arm <- ifelse(conc$y_target_name %in% c("AMELY"),
                             "Yp (AMELY/AMELX)", "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)")

    conc_filtered <- conc %>% dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("LOY", "CTRL", "Parental"),
                                             !is.na(Conc_ratio), is.finite(Conc_ratio))

    # Pool by averaging concentration across replicates (within probe arm)
    conc_pooled <- conc_filtered %>%
      dplyr::group_by(passage, condition, probe_arm) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Conc_ratio = mean(Conc_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
                       n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

    conc_pooled$cond_arm <- interaction(conc_pooled$condition, conc_pooled$probe_arm, sep = " / ")

    ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = conc_filtered,
        aes(x = passage, y = Conc_ratio, color = condition, shape = probe_arm),
        size = 3, alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(0.4)) +
      geom_point(data = conc_pooled,
        aes(x = passage, y = Conc_ratio, color = condition, shape = probe_arm),
        size = 4, position = position_dodge(0.4)) +
      geom_line(data = conc_pooled,
        aes(x = passage, y = Conc_ratio, color = condition, group = cond_arm,
            linetype = probe_arm),
        linewidth = 1, position = position_dodge(0.4)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("LOY" = "#E64B35", "CTRL" = "#4DBBD5", "Parental" = "#00A087")) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = 16, "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = 17)) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = "solid", "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = "dashed")) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.15)) +
      labs(
        title = "HT1080 — Concentration Ratio Across Passages",
        subtitle = "Y-target / Reference (copies/\u00b5L)\nCircle = Yp arm; Triangle = Yq arm",
        x = "Passage", y = "Concentration Ratio",
        color = "Condition", shape = "Probe Locus", linetype = "Probe Locus"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.box = "vertical")
  } else {
    cat("No HT1080 Y-target entries in data_table.csv")
  }
} else {
  cat("No data_table.csv found in any run directory.")
}
```

## Summary — Fold Change vs CTRL

```{r fold-change-table}
fc <- pooled %>%
  dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("LOY", "CTRL")) %>%
  dplyr::select(passage, condition, probe_arm, ratio) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = ratio) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fold_LOY_vs_CTRL = LOY / CTRL,
    pct_reduction = round((1 - fold_LOY_vs_CTRL) * 100, 1)
  )

fc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "LOY vs CTRL fold change at each passage and probe arm",
    col.names = c("Passage", "Probe Locus", "CTRL Ratio", "LOY Ratio", "Fold (LOY/CTRL)", "% Reduction")
  )
```

```{r fold-change-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
fc <- fc %>% dplyr::filter(passage %in% c("D0", "P3", "P4"))

if (nrow(fc) > 0) {
  ggplot(fc, aes(x = passage, y = pct_reduction, fill = probe_arm)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.6), width = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_reduction, "%"), group = probe_arm),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, position = position_dodge(0.6)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yp (AMELY/AMELX)" = "#E64B35",
                                 "Yq (KDM5D or DDX3Y/RNaseP)" = "#3C5488")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(fc$pct_reduction, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2)) +
    labs(
      title = "HT1080 — Y Chromosome Reduction vs CTRL",
      x = "Passage", y = "% Reduction vs CTRL", fill = "Probe Locus"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```
